scenes.text: Vampire bats share their blood meals with hungry friends.
They don't suck blood. They make a tiny cut and lap it up.
A bat that misses two or three nights of food can starve to death.
So bats that fed well throw up some blood for roostmates who went hungry.
Scientists found they even share with bats that aren't family.
And these bonds can last for years, a lot like friendships.
Spooky or sweet? Tell me in the comments.

title: Vampire bats share blood with their friends 🦇
caption: Vampire bats can starve after missing 2-3 nights of food, so well-fed bats regurgitate blood for hungry roostmates, even unrelated ones. Researchers say these sharing bonds can last for years. 🦇
